## Power and runtime (from the MuJoCo walking run)

- Mean servo current while walking: **2.82 A** at ~11.1 V → with 9 W compute: **40.3 W**
- 3S 3000 mAh pack, 85 % usable (28.3 Wh): about **42 min** of walking
- Sum of per-joint peak currents seen in the walk: 12.8 A (never simultaneous) → 20 A fuse. All servos stalled: 60.4 A (protected by torque limit + fuse).
